question: What happens to the soul's power above the eight nāḍīs?
premises: The soul's power assumes as many corresponding forms.
By assuming those forms it attains fullness.
Above the eight nāḍīs an eightfold set of forms is taught.
inference: The expansive power of the soul becomes complete by manifesting as an eightfold set of forms above the nāḍīs.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the eight forms is explained in the following verses.
plain_english: Taking on that many forms, that power attains fullness. Above the eight nāḍīs, an eightfold set of forms is taught.
